evidence_items.explanation: The study reports unstable causal-graph answers, but also GPT-3 successes on 11 of 15 abstract questions and 21 of 36 intuitive-physics questions. Its limited model coverage and unspecified experiment dates prevent treating it as a comprehensive December 2022 outcome test.

The paper develops an algorithm for determining whether causal effects are identifiable and estimating them when they are, given structural constraints. This challenges a reading that existing approaches were uniformly ineffective, but does not demonstrate broad autonomous causal reasoning in December 2022.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved evaluation establishes the broad performance of all relevant approaches during December 2022.
The source provides no task domain or adequacy threshold that distinguishes useful specialist methods from the general capability Marcus appears to require.
The language-model experiments report both successes and failures; neither establishes the adequacy of the wider field.
